answer: The seed words are divided into overlapping groups, so any two groups together contain every word while one group alone is incomplete. Losing one group still leaves a working pair, but a thief holding one group learns only part of the phrase. Compromising a full seed needs two groups per identity, doubling the theft effort for each fake account. The record keeps every dune visible, so anyone can audit the handover. Between a nebula and a kernel lies the whole point: Sybils are cheap to make but expensive to prove.
